result.summary: The home screen has several layout overflow issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edges, and the last Popular restaurant card is cut off by the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding to the horizontal list or ensure the last visible card is fully on-screen with a peek of the next item rather than cutting text.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is clipped at the right edge of the screen, so the pill shape and label are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the category chip row and keep a visible peek of the next chip so filters are not cut off.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' restaurant card is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, so the image, discount badge, and favorite control are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The category row alignment looks uneven because the trailing chip is cropped, making the filter bar feel unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Use a horizontally scrollable chip list with equal start/end insets so all chips remain fully visible.
